svg.title: What is included (dark, narrow)
svg.desc: What is included: Dashboard: The real Supabase Studio, with multiple organizations and projects. Every project: Postgres, Auth, REST, GraphQL, Realtime, Storage, Edge Functions and custom domains. Compute sizes: Nano to 16XL per project, like hosted, resized from the dashboard. Supabase CLI: Link, push migrations and manage branches, with a profile file. Branching: Like hosted: branches carry schema, functions and settings, and merge in the dashboard. GitHub previews: A preview branch per pull request, with a check and a comment, from your own GitHub App. MCP for AI tools: Claude Code, Cursor and VS Code sign in to your server's MCP endpoint with OAuth. AI Assistant: Studio's AI Assistant with your own key, on OpenAI or any OpenAI-compatible gateway. Advisors: Hosted's security and performance database checks, in the dashboard, CLI and MCP. Monitoring: CPU, memory and disk reports, resource warnings, and alerts by email or webhook. Backups: Point-in-time restore from the dashboard, including Storage files. Move from hosted: Move a project from hosted Supabase with its data, users and legacy keys, or back again. Storage on S3: Move Storage's files to an S3 bucket in place, with a short pause for writes. Read replicas: A copy of a project on a second server, with its own API and pooler endpoints. Failover: Switch a project or the whole server to its replica, by hand or automatically on AWS. Teams: Organizations, roles, invitations, SAML single sign-on and MFA. API keys: Publishable and secret keys, legacy JWT keys and key rotation. Operations: Automatic HTTPS, security patches and signed updates. Upgrades: One command brings servers and AWS stacks forward from v0.1.x, backed up first. AWS: A one-field CloudFormation template, and a second stack for a replica server. Generated by brand/build.py.
